issues.detail: The Greek 'δε' (de) is a conjunction meaning 'but' or 'however', but the Vietnamese translation uses 'trung tín' (faithful/loyal), which is not present in the Greek text. The word 'trung tín' appears to be an addition/substitution that changes the grammatical function of the sentence.
The Greek 'βεβαιαν' (bebaian) means 'surely' or 'certainly', which is omitted in the Vietnamese translation.
